searchText: glad it worked <@!425615769280315392> I ran a sync against the nethermind node, creating a bunch of random transactions periodically, logging warnings anytime we paused the evm execution because data was missing, and never saw any such warnings when the witness downloader was enabled, so it looks like it's working as expected. I also confirmed that it was downloading the trie nodes after fetching the witness hashes I've submitted a couple PRs with the witness hashes DB and the protocol; once those are in I'll submit the one that actually downloads witnesses when we receive a NewBlock
